selected_problem: Fresh-main inspection of the current semantic-repository truth boundary found a narrower directly falsifiable defect inside the resolver's existing index-inference model: a relative import with explicit directory intent such as './foo/' normalizes to a trailing-slash target, but the current index-prefix construction adds another slash, so an existing 'foo/index.js' is not linked at all. Simply stripping the slash globally would be incorrect because it could instead link the import to a sibling 'foo.js' file and erase the caller's directory intent.
decision_basis: The defect is a local contradiction inside the resolver behavior already present on main: extensionless paths support bounded index inference, while the same inference becomes unreachable when the specifier explicitly carries a trailing slash.
The repair does not choose a new parser, bundler, TypeScript, Node package-resolution stack, filesystem identity policy, or product shape.
Directory intent can be preserved by allowing index fallback for the normalized directory target while refusing direct-file and added-extension fallbacks for that same trailing-slash import.
changes: core/semantic-repo-graph.mjs now preserves whether the normalized import carried trailing-slash directory intent and resolves that intent only against index candidates under the target directory.
Direct-file and added-extension candidates remain available for ordinary extensionless imports but are excluded when directory intent is explicit.
tests/semantic-import-target-resolution.test.mjs adds a regression proving './foo/' resolves 'foo/index.js' without incorrectly linking a sibling 'foo.js'.

truth_boundary: Filesystem case/Unicode identity, conflicting-content aliases outside the current lexical canonicalization model, parser-grade Node/TypeScript/bundler/package module resolution, query/hash import semantics, and arbitrary complex repository synthesis remain UNRESOLVED. This cycle closes only the trailing-slash directory-intent contradiction inside the existing bounded relative-import resolver.
